data.title: 初雪 · 谢拉格风铃畔的雪豹私语
data.action: 跪坐在白熊皮地毯上，双手将巨大蓬松的雪豹尾巴抱在怀里，雪白豹耳微颤，眼神带着摆脱圣女沉重职责后的纯真娇柔。
data.location: 谢拉格圣殿最高神龛后侧的隐秘暖阁，银质香炉升起细细雪莲熏香
data.lighting: 神龛长明酥油灯散发温暖柔和的金红火光，与窗外肆虐的风雪蓝夜形成鲜明温差
data.mood: 褪去神圣外壳后回归少女本真的依赖与温存，毛茸茸的极度治愈
data.description: 谢拉格圣殿最高神龛后侧的隐秘暖阁，银质香炉升起细细雪莲熏香。跪坐在白熊皮地毯上，双手将巨大蓬松的雪豹尾巴抱在怀里，雪白豹耳微颤，眼神带着摆脱圣女沉重职责后的纯真娇柔。 她微微抬眸轻语——“在这里……请不要叫我圣女大人。就只是恩雅，只属于你一个人的恩雅……这样可以吗？”
data.promptProse: Pramanix kneels barefoot on a thick white fur rug inside the warm inner sanctuary behind the Kjerag summit altar, wearing a translucent silver-white silk slip dress trimmed with soft white fur and a tiny silver bell anklet. Cradling her plush snow leopard tail against her chest, she looks toward the viewer with an unguarded blush as warm oil-lamp light glows against the snowy night outside.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling barefoot on a white fur rug in a sheer fur-trimmed white silk slip dress, she hugs her fluffy tail to her chest and looks up with a soft, relieved blush. Butter-lamp glow warms the quiet mountain shrine as thin incense smoke drifts from a silver censer.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a translucent silver-white silk slip dress edged with soft white fur trim along the neckline and hem, plus a small silver bell ribbon tied at her ankle.
